Methods for fitted JDemetra+ models

Source: R/jd3_indicator.R, R/methods.R
jd3_model_methods.Rd

Standard fabletools / generics verbs for models fitted with X13(), TRAMOSEATS(), REGARIMA() and TRAMO(). They can be applied directly on a mable. components() is only available for the seasonal adjustment models (X13() and TRAMOSEATS()).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'jd3_model'
glance(x, ids = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jd3_sa_model'
components(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jd3_model'
model_sum(x)

# S3 method for class 'jd3_model'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jd3_model'
report(
  object,
  digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L),
  signif.stars = getOption("show.signif.stars"),
  thresholds_pval = getOption("fable.rjd3.thresholds_pval"),
  ...
)

Arguments

ids

For glance(): named or unnamed character vector of indicator ids (see jd3_dictionary()); the names become the column names. Numbers and strings give one column; tests give two columns, <name>_stat and <name>_pvalue; other indicators give NA. If NULL, the default set of the method is used (information criteria, number of observations, tests on the residuals and on the seasonally adjusted series, M and Q statistics for X-13, SEATS tests for TRAMO-SEATS).

...

Currently unused.

object, x

A jd3_model (usually accessed through a mable).

digits

minimum number of significant digits to be used for most numbers.

signif.stars

logical; if TRUE, P-values are additionally encoded visually as ‘significance stars’ in order to help scanning of long coefficient tables. It defaults to the show.signif.stars slot of options.

thresholds_pval

Threshold used to interpret p-values statistic test. By default c(Severe = 0.001, Bad = 0.01, Uncertain = 0.05, Good = Inf).

Value

  • components(): a dable with the response and the columns trend, seasonal, irregular and season_adjust.

  • glance(): a one-row tibble of diagnostics.

  • tidy(): a tibble with one row per coefficient (ARIMA parameters, regression variables, outliers, calendar effects) and the columns term, estimate, std.error, statistic and p.value. Coefficients fixed in the specification are included, with missing standard errors and tests.

  • report(): invisibly, the model; prints the decomposition mode or the transformation, the number of observations, the coefficients, the tests on the residuals and, for seasonal adjustment models, the quality diagnostics (M and Q statistics, residual seasonality tests on the adjusted series).

  • model_sum(): a short string describing the model.

Examples

mb <- model(tsibble::as_tsibble(AirPassengers), x13 = X13(value))
components(mb)
#> # A dable: 144 x 7 [1M]
#> # Key:     .model [1]
#> # :        value = trend * seasonal * irregular
#>    .model    index value trend seasonal irregular season_adjust
#>    <chr>     <mth> <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>         <dbl>
#>  1 x13    1949 Jan   112  122.    0.920     0.996          122.
#>  2 x13    1949 Feb   118  124.    0.948     1.00           125.
#>  3 x13    1949 Mar   132  126.    1.05      0.994          125.
#>  4 x13    1949 Apr   129  128.    1.00      1.01           129.
#>  5 x13    1949 May   121  128.    0.939     1.01           129.
#>  6 x13    1949 Jun   135  127.    1.07      0.998          127.
#>  7 x13    1949 Jul   148  126.    1.19      0.988          125.
#>  8 x13    1949 Aug   148  126.    1.17      0.999          126.
#>  9 x13    1949 Sep   136  127.    1.07      1.00           128.
#> 10 x13    1949 Oct   119  128.    0.925     1.00           129.
#> # ℹ 134 more rows
glance(mb)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 19
#>   .model  aicc  nobs nparams  nout lb_stat lb_pvalue normality_stat
#>   <chr>  <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl>          <dbl>
#> 1 x13     947.   144       6     1    23.9     0.354          0.763
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: normality_pvalue <dbl>, ftest_sa_stat <dbl>,
#> #   ftest_sa_pvalue <dbl>, qs_test_sa_stat <dbl>, qs_test_sa_pvalue <dbl>,
#> #   combined_test_sa <chr>, combined_test_sa_lastyears <chr>,
#> #   td_on_sa_stat <dbl>, td_on_sa_pvalue <dbl>, Q <dbl>, Q_M2 <dbl>
tidy(mb)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 6
#>   .model term         estimate std.error statistic  p.value
#>   <chr>  <chr>           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 x13    theta(1)     -0.116    0.109        -1.06 2.89e- 1
#> 2 x13    btheta(1)    -0.497    0.0723       -6.88 2.55e-10
#> 3 x13    td2          -0.00295  0.000533     -5.53 1.79e- 7
#> 4 x13    easter [1]    0.0178   0.00730       2.43 1.63e- 2
#> 5 x13    AO (1951-05)  0.100    0.0208        4.81 4.33e- 6
report(mb)
